description:
scimt.eval.capability (judge-free MMLU+GSM8K) currently feeds only the noise arm. Emit (B, capability) each benign/adversarial FT step -> Pareto curves (LW #6 control vs 'erosion = generic capability loss'). EXIT: benign-FT summary.json carries per-step capability alongside B.

## Notes
Capability (MMLU+GSM8K) is emitted per checkpoint by pod/sample.py + probes.score_rows (Pareto B,C available for every eval). The benign/adversarial FT-arm CHAINING that consumes it is Phase 2/3 (smt-4hz.6/.7) and reuses this same harness.
